annotations.title: Request a hotline call (incl. waiting on hold)

description: Request that we call a hotline or authority, wait on hold, and obtain an answer or complete a simple request on behalf of an authorised account holder. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price on request – quoted individually, with volume tiers.

account_holder_name.description: Optional: account holder (required for account-specific matters).

authorization_confirmed.description: True if the account holder has authorised us to act for this matter.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.
